descriere: Confirms the new password for know-how protection.
Sets the new password for know-how protection.
Sets the station name for the onboard PROFINET interface on the Control Unit. The active station name is displayed in r8930.
Displays the PROFINET Device Access Point ID (DAP ID) for the onboard PROFINET interface. The combination of device ID (r8909) and DAP ID uniquely identifies a PROFINET access point.
Displays the IP address of the second PROFINET controller connected with the device via PN onboard.
Displays the status of the memory card.

Displays the first index of the parameters that could not be transferred when the parameter backup files (PS files) were read from the non-volatile memory (e.g. memory card). If, from an indexed parameter, at least one index was not able to be transferred, then the parameter number is dis- played in r9406[n] and the first index that was not transferred is displayed in r9407[n].
Displays the set valid macro.

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections signal source search count
descriere: Displays the number of BICO interconnections to the signal sink being searched for.
Displays the PROFIsafe telegram to be sent on processor 1. Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4 [4] = PZD 5 [5] = PZD 6 [6] = PZD 7 [7] = PZD 8
Displays the supported Safety Integrated monitoring functions. Processor 2 determines this display.
Displays the supported Safety Integrated monitoring functions. Processor 1 determines this display.
The parameter is used for diagnostics.
Displays the clock cycle time for the Safety Integrated Basic Functions on processor 1.
Displays the checksum for the Safety Integrated parameters checked using checksums on processor 2 (actual checksum).
Sets the PROFIsafe telegram number.
This parameter is identical to r0945.
Sets a value for the fixed speed / velocity setpoint 3.
Displays additional information about the fault that occurred (as integer number).

Selects bits to be sent to the PROFIdrive controller. The individual bits are combined to form status word 2. Index: [0] = Bit 0 [1] = Bit 1 [2] = Bit 2 [3] = Bit 3 [4] = Bit 4 [5] = Bit 5 [6] = Bit 6 [7] = Bit 7 [8] = Bit 8 [9] = Bit 9 [10] = Bit 10 [11] = Bit 11 [12] = Bit 12 [13] = Bit 13 [14] = Bit 14 [15] = Bit 15
Sets the speed threshold value for the signal "|n_act| < speed threshold value 3" (BO: r2199.0).
Sets the hysteresis speed (bandwidth) for the following signals: "|n_act| < speed threshold value 3" (BO: r2199.0) "n_set >= 0" (BO: r2198.5) "n_act >= 0" (BO: r2197.3)

descriere_scurta: Motor holding brake starting frequency signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the frequency setting value at the slip compensation output for starting up with motor holding brake.

Sets the dynamic factor for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering). 100% means that p1290, p1291, and p1292 (gain, integral time, and rate time) are used corresponding to their basic settings and based on a theoretical controller optimization. If subsequent optimization is required, this can be carried out using the dynamic factor. In this case, p1290, p1291, and p1292 are weighted with the dynamic factor p1287.

descriere_scurta: Speed at the start of DC braking
descriere: Sets the starting speed for DC braking. If the actual speed falls below this threshold, then DC braking is activated.

Sets the switch-off delay time for the negated signal "run-up completed". The message "torque setpoint < p2174" (BO: r2198.10) and "torque utilization < p2194" (BO: r2199.11) are only evaluated after the run-up and the delay time has expired.

Sets the alarm threshold for power unit overtemperatures. The value is set as a difference to the tripping (shut- down) temperature. Drive: If this threshold is exceeded, an overload alarm is generated and the system responds as parameterized in p0290. Infeed: When the threshold value is exceeded, only an overload alarm is output. Index: [0] = Heat sink temperature [1] = Power semiconductor (chip) temperature

Determines the width of the dead zone at the analog input. Analog input type unipolar (e.g. 0 ... +10 V): The dead zone starts with the characteristic value x1/y1 (p0757/p0758). Analog input type bipolar (e.g. -10 V ... +10 V): The dead zone is located at the symmetrical center between characteristic value x1/y1 (p0757/p0758) and x2/y2 (p0759/p0760). The set value doubles the dead zone. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs activate absolute value generation
descriere: Activates the absolute value generation for the analog outputs.

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs characteristic value x1
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog outputs. The scaling characteristic for the analog outputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate (percentage) of the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs characteristic value y1
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog outputs. The scaling characteristic for the analog outputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (output voltage in V or output current in mA) of the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs characteristic value x2
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog outputs. The scaling characteristic for the analog outputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate (percentage) of the 2nd value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)
Sets faults for which automatic restart should not be effective.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller speed actual value smoothing time (SLVC)
descriere: Sets the smoothing time for the actual speed of the speed controller for encoderless closed-loop speed control.
Sets the smoothing time for the flux setpoint.

descriere_scurta: Comm IF USS PZD send word
descriere: Selects the PZD (actual values) to be sent via the commissioning interface USS. The actual values are displayed on an intelligent operator panel (IOP). Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4

Setting to invert the individual binector inputs of the binector connector converter. Index: [0] = Status word 1 [1] = Status word 2 [2] = Free status word 3 [3] = Free status word 4 [4] = Free status word 5

descriere_scurta: Current threshold value reached delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the comparison of the current actual value (r0068) with the current threshold value (p2170).

For the energy-saving display of a fluid-flow machine, a typical flow characteristic P = f(n) with 5 points along the characteristic is required. This parameter specifies the speed (n) of point 1 as a [%]. The characteristic comprises the following value pairs: Power (P) / speed (n)
Sets the signal source for command 1 for the two-wire control/three-wire control.

descriere_scurta: Pe energy-saving mode pause time minimal
descriere: Sets the minimum possible pause time for the energy-saving mode. The value is the sum of the following times: - Energy-saving mode transition time - Operating state transition time - Energy-saving mode, dwell time minimal Index: [0] = Reserved [1] = Mode 2

descriere_scurta: Pe energy-saving mode dwell time maximum
descriere: Sets the maximum dwell time for the energy-saving mode. Index: [0] = Reserved [1] = Mode 2
Sets the mode-dependent properties for energy-saving. Index: [0] = Reserved [1] = Mode 2

descriere_scurta: KHP Control Unit reference serial number
descriere: Sets the reference serial number for the Control Unit. Using this parameter, if a Control Unit and/or a memory card is replaced at the end customer, the OEM can again adapt the project to the modified hardware.

Sets the password for know-how protection. Example of a password: 123aBc = 49 50 51 97 66 99 dec (ASCII characters) [0] = character 1 (e.g. 49 dec) [1] = character 2 (e.g. 50 dec) ... [5] = character 6 (e.g. 99 dec) [29] = 0 dec (completes the entry)

descriere_scurta: KHP memory card reference serial number
descriere: Sets the reference serial number for the memory card. Using this parameter, if a Control Unit and/or a memory card is replaced at the end customer, the OEM can again adapt the project to the modified hardware.
Sets the IP address for the onboard PROFINET interface on the Control Unit. The active IP address is displayed in r8931.
Sets the default gateway for the onboard PROFINET interface on the Control Unit. The active default gateway is displayed in r8932.
Sets the subnet mask for the onboard PROFINET interface on the Control Unit. The active subnet mask is displayed in r8933.
Displays the smoothed converter frequency.
Displays the smoothed actual value of the modulation depth.
Operating display for the drive.
Displays the firmware version of the Control Unit.
Displays the energy values at the output terminals of the power unit. Index: [0] = Energy balance (sum) [1] = Energy drawn [2] = Energy fed back
Display and connector output for the speed setpoint after the setpoint filters.
Displays the maximum output current of the power unit.
Displays the field-generating current setpoint (Id_set).
Displays the transformation angle.
Displays the bootloader version. Index 0: Displays the bootloader version. Index 1: Displays the bootloader version 3 (for CU320-2 and CU310-2) Value 0 means that boot loader 3 is not available.

descriere_scurta: Rated power unit line supply voltage
descriere: Displays the rated line supply voltage of the power unit.

descriere_scurta: Power unit alarm with I2t overload
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for the I2t power unit overload. If this threshold is exceeded, an overload alarm is generated and the system responds as parameterized in p0290.
Threshold to detect a DC link undervoltage. If the DC link voltage falls below this threshold, the drive unit is tripped due to a DC link undervoltage condition.
If the DC link voltage exceeds the threshold specified here, the drive unit is tripped due to DC link overvoltage.
Setting to invert the digital input signals to connect a measuring probe.
Sets the input terminal for the measuring probe for speed actual value measurement.
Sets the edge to evaluate the measuring probe signal for speed actual value measurement. 0: 0/1 edge 1: 1/0 edge
Sets the number of pulses per revolution (e.g. for disks with holes).
Sets the maximum measuring time for the measuring probe. If a new pulse is not received before the maximum measuring time has expired, then the speed actual value in

descriere_scurta: is set to zero. This timer is re-started with the next pulse.
descriere: Sets the BERO gear factor. The measured speed is multiplied by the BERO gear factor and is displayed in r0586.

Displays the time between the last two BERO pulses. The measuring time is specified as 32-bit value with a resolution of 1/48 µs. If a new pulse is not received before the maximum measured time in p0583 expires, then r0587 is set to the maxi- mum measuring time.
Displays the number of measuring pulses that have occurred (been received) up until now.

Displays the time since the last measuring pulse was detected. The delay time is specified as 32-bit value with a resolution of 1/48 µs. When a measuring pulse occurs (is received) the delay time is reset and is limited to the maximum measuring time in p0583.

descriere_scurta: Rs identification stator resistance after switch on again
descriere: Displays the stator resistance determined using the Rs identification after switching on again.

descriere_scurta: CU digital inputs terminal actual value
descriere: Displays the actual value at the digital inputs. This means that the actual input signal can be checked at terminal DI x or DI/DO x prior to switching from the simu- lation mode (p0795.x = 1) to terminal mode (p0795.x = 0).

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DO 2
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DO 2 (NO: T. 24 / NC: T. 23).
Displays the status of digital outputs.

descriere_scurta: Command data set selection CDS bit 1
descriere: Sets the signal source to select the Command Data Set bit 1 (CDS bit 1).

Sets the monitoring time for the power unit. The monitoring time is started after an 0/1 edge of the ON/OFF1 command. If the power unit does not return a READY signal within the monitoring time, fault F07802 is output.
Sets the signal source to select the "parking axis" function.

descriere_scurta: Motor. potentiometer setpoint after the ramp-function generator /
descriere: Sets the effective setpoint after the internal motorized potentiometer ramp-function generator. This setpoint is the output value of the motorized potentiometer and must be appropriately interconnected onwards (e.g. with the main setpoint).
Displays the effective supplementary setpoint. The value shown is the additional setpoint after scaling.
Sets the ramp-function generator type.
Displays the speed setpoint after the addition of the speed setpoint 1 (p1155) and speed setpoint 2 (p1160).
Sets the signal source for lowest possible motor speed.
Displays the number of the selected fixed speed/velocity setpoint.

Sets the monitoring time for the standstill identification. When braking with OFF1 or OFF3, standstill is identified after this time has expired, after the setpoint speed has fallen below p1226 (also refer to p1145).

Sets the delay time for pulse suppression. After OFF1 or OFF3, the pulses are canceled, if at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled: - the speed actual value falls below the threshold in p1226 and the time started after this in p1228 has expired. - the speed setpoint falls below the threshold in p1226 and the time started after this in p1227 has expired.

descriere_scurta: Vdc_max controller automatic detection ON signal level (U/f)
descriere: Activates/de-activates the automatic sensing of the switch-in level for the Vdc_max controller. When the sensing function is de-activated, the activation threshold r1282 for the Vdc_max controller is determined from the parame- terized connection voltage p0210.
Displays the actual output of the Vdc controller (DC link voltage controller)
Displays the actual compensated slip [%] referred to r0330 (rated motor slip).
Displays the speed setpoint for the I component of the speed controller (output of the reference model after the set- point limiting).

Displays the sum of all speed setpoints that are present. The following sources are available for the displayed setpoint: - setpoint at the ramp-function generator input (r1119). - speed setpoint 1 (p1155). - speed setpoint 2 (p1160). - speed setpoint for the speed pre-control (p1430). - setpoint from DSC (for DSC active). - setpoint via PC (for master control active).
Displays the actual smoothed actual speed for speed control.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller system deviation I component
descriere: Displays the system deviation of the I component of the speed controller.
Displays the effective P gain of the speed controller.
Displays the effective integral time of the speed controller.
Display and connector output for the torque setpoint at the output of the I speed controller.
Displays the output signal of the droop calculation. The droop feedback result is subtracted from the speed setpoint when activated (p1492).
Displays the maximum limit for the torque-generating current component. Index 0 indicates the signal limited by the Vdc controller. Index: [0] = Limited [1] = Unlimited
Displays the minimum limit for the torque-generating current component. Index 0 indicates the signal limited by the Vdc controller. Index: [0] = Limited [1] = Unlimited
